product_metadata.title: DII Everyday Kitchen Collection Assorted Dishcloth Set, 12x12, Stone, 5 Count
features: PERFECT DISHCLOTHS TO TACKLE ANY JOB: Made in India, these 100% cotton dishcloths measure 12x12" each to tackle all of your kitchen tasks
EASY CARE, LONG-LASTING MATERIAL: Machine washable; Wash with cold water on gentle cycle and tumble dry low; Do not bleach or run through a hot dryer
ULTRA ABSORBENT AND LOW LINT: These towels are lightweight, super absorbent, dry quickly, and are durable enough for daily use
ATTRACTIVE AND FUNCTIONAL: With a variety of colors and designs, these dishcloths are the perfect aesthetic addition to your space; Add a splash of color to your kitchen
FOR MORE DII: DII is a highly respected name in home goods; Click DII above or search "DII" to explore more of our stunning collections for all seasons
description: These Dish cloths are an everyday kitchen essential to keep your kitchen clean and dry. Cloths are 100% cotton with classic colors and design to coordinate with most kitchen décor. With each wash, these towels become more absorbent, helping to clean up even the biggest messes including tough kitchen grease, dirt, food, and more. Made with high quality cotton with tight knit allow for less lint on your glass or plates. Washing and Care Instructions: Wash towels before first use, Use Cold water, Color Separated; DO NOT use bleach Do not use fabric softener (coats the cotton fibers causing towel to become less absorbent) Dry towels in Tumble cycle to minimize shrinkage. May be ironed with low heat. Dishcloths will lose any lint remaining from the weaving process, and will become softer and more absorbent after washing.
